verdict.rationale: Nix is software you install and run on your own machines. The docs cover a multi-user daemon installer, installing NixOS on physical hardware, and an official EC2 AMI. Community reports confirm teams running their own build infrastructure, including large remote builder fleets shared across dev, CI and deployment, and custom ISOs built from a config file. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license, and first-party docs on self-hosting supporting infrastructure such as a private binary cache.
